attribution: Terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey.
Produced using Copernicus data and information funded by the European Union - EU-DEM layers.
dataset: Mapzen/Tilezen Skadi terrain tiles (HGT, composited real-world DEM)
dataset_note: Composited from several public elevation sources; not necessarily original NASA SRTM exclusively. No ground-truth accuracy is claimed.

extent.note: samples sit on the integer-degree grid; both edges are included

normalization.equation: u = h + 32768 (h: signed int16 meters, u: uint16 little-endian)
normalization.inverse: h = u - 32768, stored as big-endian int16, reproduces the original HGT bytes exactly

processing: none: no smoothing, clipping, interpolation, resizing or region selection
raw_format: signed int16 big-endian meters, rows north-to-south, nodata -32768
source_imagery_note: No source imagery header was present in the response; sources are not identified.
